system.description:
Tidal bogs and reed marsh, where land and water blur. Paths shift with the tide and the water hides what lies in it. People trust few strangers and learn which ground will hold.

Talent: one Finesse die to d10, one Wit die to d10.

  • Fen Curse. You learn the Fen Curse Technique: Ranged, -1 Oppose (1 minute).
  • Mire Cunning. +2 Training in Guile.
